summary: Deliver live declared reminder messages and expose steps waiting for actual declaration state

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild. Existing native boot and reconnect age/offer exclusions remain; historical declared messages are not replayed.

rules.detail: Checkpoint timing uses the existing shared fold; declaration waits retain their execution budget.

compatibility.detail: Uses existing blocked step status and message receipt contracts. A desired declaration proves queued mail only, never delivery.

recovery.detail: Live declarations use their selected admission claim for existing native delivery eligibility. A declaration-only step waits visibly for actual state and resumes after that evidence arrives.
